name: Segmen Kardesler Gid Urt Ve Amblj Sny AS
summary: Segmen Kardesler Gida Üretim ve Ambalaj Sanayi Anonim Sirketi is a Turkish firm primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of an extensive range of food items within Turkey. Its diverse product portfolio includes various types of jams, such as traditional, diabetic, sugar-free, and probiotic options. The company also provides honey, conventional and diabetic halva, peanut butter, tahini, grape molasses, and tahini molasses. Furthermore, its offerings extend to Turkish delight, a wide assortment of spices, herbal teas, and butter. Consumers can also purchase its products through online platforms. Established in 1938, the company maintains its headquarters in Ankara, Turkey.
